artworks.title: Roman Ruin (Ruine romaine)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with trees, shrubs, and rocks. There are hills in the distance and a sky overhead. The artwork is created using detailed etching with visible lines showcasing textures and depth. The color palette consists of shades of black and gray, creating contrast.

artworks.title: Little Wandering Jew (Le petit juif errant)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a traveler walking with a stick along a path. The background features a large, twisting tree trunk. The artwork uses detailed cross-hatching lines to create texture and depth in the tree's bark and the traveler's clothing. The monochromatic palette emphasizes contrasts and adds a dramatic tone to the setting.

artworks.title: Woods in Winter Sun, 2nd plate (Soleil d'hiver dans les bois)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a monochrome etching depicting a dense forest scene. The scene shows trees and undergrowth, with detailed textures and patterns. Tall trees are visible, with branches forming intricate patterns against a pale background. The horizon is obscured by the dense arrangement of trees. The etching uses a restricted color palette of black and off-white, creating a high-contrast image that emphasizes light, shadow, foliage details, and tree forms.

artworks.title: Farm on a Hill (La ferme sur la colline)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape scene with hills in the distance. A detailed tree is on the left, and a figure in a wide-brimmed hat sits near a horse in the center. On a hill in the distance, a faintly outlined building is visible. The etching technique creates texture through cross-hatching. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Old Chateau (Un vieux chateau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is an etching presenting a landscape view from an elevated perspective. The horizon line is near the upper third where the sky meets the distant land without distinct separation. The field of view is dominated by indistinct forms, with faint outlines of possibly distant trees or terrain on the horizon. The etching technique employs fine, closely spaced lines and cross-hatching for texture and depth on the terrain, castle, and foliage. Two figures recline against the slope, directing attention towards the middle of the scene. In the distance, a slope leads to an elevated structure, likely a castle with battlements, blending into the background through fine line work. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray on a light background, creating a serene visual effect.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait, 4th plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man's head and shoulders in profile view. His head is turned slightly to his left, and he has prominent facial features including high cheekbones, a prominent nose, and deep-set eyes. He has a full head of hair, a large white beard and mustache covering much of his face and neck. He is dressed in a high-collared garment. The background is textured with cross-hatching and the overall tone is monochromatic, using various shades of black and white. There are no visible signs of jewelry, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Bend in the River (Un coin de riviere)
artworks.medium: etching retouched with sepia ink and wash
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene with trees partially covering the horizon. A figure is in a boat in the center, close to the viewer. The brushstrokes are detailed, depicting foliage and water with crosshatching. Earth tones dominate the color palette, creating a peaceful atmosphere.

artworks.title: Bridge at the Mill (Le pont du moulin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a rustic scene with buildings on the left side blending into the natural surroundings. The horizon is not clearly visible due to trees and foliage. The etching technique is used with meticulous and textured brushstrokes, including cross-hatching for depth and shading. The color palette is monochrome with shades of grey. A large tree dominates the center, with a path leading through the landscape to distant hills.

artworks.title: Bridge at the Mill (Le pont du moulin)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: In the image, there is a wooded area with trees and a building. The viewpoint is slightly elevated. The horizon is not clearly visible. There is a rustic building on the left with a thatched roof, partly hidden by trees. The artwork shows detailed cross-hatched brushstrokes creating textures and shadows. The color scheme is monochromatic, using different shades of gray. The image features dense foliage and architectural elements depicted closely, extending into the distance with more trees in the background.

artworks.title: Landscape with Boat, 2nd plate (Paysage au bateau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a body of water, a figure in a boat, and another figure by the water's edge. Lush vegetation fills the scene, obscuring the high horizon line that shows distant hills and structures. The brushstrokes are delicate and precise, creating texture and depth in the foliage and figures. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and beige, evoking tranquility.

artworks.title: Farm at the Monastery (La ferme de l'abbaye)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The scene depicts a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated angle, with scattered structures and foliage under a vast sky. The horizon is visible as the buildings meet the sky, which is dominated by a large cloud formation casting shadows below. The etching technique uses fine linework and cross-hatching to create texture and depth. The image is rendered in monochromatic tones, predominantly sepia. Close to the viewer, patches of rough ground are etched in varied directions, leading the eye to the clustered buildings. In the distance, the sky opens up beyond the buildings, contrasting with the solid forms below.

artworks.title: Remembrance of Italy (Souvenir d'Italie)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This artwork features a view from a slightly elevated position, looking down into a rugged landscape. The horizon is set high in the composition, with undulating hills and trees blending into the misty sky. A bridge crosses horizontally in the middle distance, an arch creating an area of light against the surroundings. The technique consists of fine, cross-hatched lines creating intricate patterns of light and shadow, giving depth and complexity. The color palette is monochromatic, using various shades of black and gray to enhance the scene's atmospheric impression. Closest to us, etched lines form foliage, while in the distance, the landscape rises to small buildings on a hill, framed by trees under a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Morning along the River (La matin sur la riviere)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside view in a detailed etching. The perspective is slightly elevated, revealing the riverbank, trees, and horizon. The riverbank is lined with tall trees, depicted with fine lines suggesting movement. The artwork uses cross-hatching for texture, especially in the foliage and grass. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of gray. A figure is stepping onto the riverbank from a boat, while another figure is seated under trees in the distance.

artworks.title: Thomas Okey, Esq.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of a person's head and upper shoulders in a frontal portrait style. The person has distinct facial features, including a strong jawline, well-proportioned nose, and deep-set eyes. The hair is neatly styled with a slight wave. The individual is dressed in a collared shirt or jacket, possibly wearing a tie. Details of the clothing are sketched with minimal intricacy. No jewelry is visible. The background is plain, emphasizing the person's face and upper body. The artist's signature "A. Legros" and the date "1903" are inscribed in the upper right corner of the image.

artworks.title: Victor Hugo, 1st plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a man's upper body, from the torso up. The man is facing slightly to the left with a contemplative expression. He has styled wavy hair, a full beard, and mustache. He is wearing a dark jacket, shirt, and bow tie, suggesting an older period attire. The background consists of finely drawn parallel lines, with the signature "A. Legros" in the top left corner.

artworks.title: Victor Hugo, 1st plate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man shown from the chest up. He is facing forward, though his body is slightly turned to the left. The man has a prominent forehead with a few lines, deep-set eyes, a broad nose, and a full beard that covers most of his lower face. His hair is wavy and tousled. He is dressed in a dark suit jacket and a buttoned-up shirt with visible broad collar and lapels. The background features a textured hatch pattern, with the signature "A. Legros" in the upper left corner, indicating the artist.

artworks.title: Edwin Edwards
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait drawing of a person seated in a chair. The person is depicted in a three-quarter view, with facial features including a full beard, mustache, and glasses. Their hair is short and combed back. They are wearing a coat or jacket over a collared shirt with visible buttons. In the background, there are vertical lines suggesting a simple backdrop. The drawing is in a monochromatic style, with the artist’s signature visible at the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Auguste Delatre
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This image is an illustration of a man from the waist up. The man is seated with his body slightly turned to the right, looking directly at the viewer. He has a mustache, beard, short wavy hair, and is wearing a collared shirt with a light scarf and a suit jacket. The background is plain, showcasing the detailed line work and shading of the illustration. The artist's signature "A. Legros" is visible in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Study of a Man's Head (Etude de tete d'homme)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body with a focus on his head and shoulders. He is seated, facing the side while looking into the distance. The man has distinct facial features, deep-set eyes, a strong nose, and full lips. His medium-length hair is parted slightly off-center and frames his face. He wears a jacket over a shirt with visible buttons. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Old Spaniard (Vieil Espagnol)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a side profile of a man seated in a thoughtful position, looking to the left. His features include a pronounced nose and an aged expression with visible lines on his face. He has short, slightly curly hair and wears a robe with a high collar. One of his hands is visible in his lap. The background is plain beige, and the artist's signature "A. Legros" is in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Horse-driven Mill (Le manege)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rural scene featuring a horse-driven well mechanism. The image depicts a horse harnessed to a manual water-drawing system, walking in a circular path to operate the mechanism. The scene includes an outdoor area with a well and a few people engaged in activities related to water collection or maintenance of the mechanism. The area surrounding the well has a rustic look, with wood and simple structures typical of a farm or rural environment. The background includes an open landscape with fields stretching out into the distance, all rendered in fine, detailed line work.

artworks.title: In the Forest of Fontainebleau (Dans le foret de Fontainebleau)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with tall trees and a dense canopy. The perspective is at eye level, emphasizing the trees. The intricate etched lines create texture and depth in a monochromatic color palette. The focus is on the detailed natural forms of the trees and leaves.

artworks.title: Wheelwright (Un charron)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows two figures working in a rustic setting. They are surrounded by trees and structures, with a high horizon and a textured sky above. The artwork uses fine etching techniques, with a monochromatic color palette of sepia and off-white.

artworks.title: Farm on a Hill (La ferme sur la colline)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of George Matthew Adams in memory of his mother, Lydia Havens Adams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a figure wearing a hat and holding a stick next to a horse on rugged terrain. In the background, there is a path leading to bushes and trees, with a structure nestled among the foliage. The scene is depicted using an etching technique with fine cross-hatching and stippling, creating a monochromatic palette of sepia tones.
